item.title: Help!!!RStudio can't run on macos 11 Big Sur
item.description: I installed this version of RStudio 2023.09.1+494 from this [this post on Posit Community](https://forum.posit.co/t/rstudio-desktop-releases-on-unsupported-versions-of-macos/176074), but it doesn't work...even just a simple command like getwd(). RStudio shows message of R Seesion Aborted. R encountered a fatal error. How can I solve this issue?? Did I download the wrong version?
